purpose: Freeze the transformation from source-locked island geography to the v4 continuous constraint axis before inspecting named-system ABM fit.

primary_mapping.name: distance_ecdf
primary_mapping.input: GIFT dist: coast-to-coast distance to nearest mainland in km
primary_mapping.transform: log1p(distance_km), then empirical CDF/rank across the frozen actual-island network locations; smallest maps near 0 and largest near 1
primary_mapping.reason: The current continuous v4 axis was defined as an isolation/opportunity axis. Rank scaling preserves the observed isolation ordering without estimating any coefficient from network outcomes.

secondary_mapping.name: geography_only_pc1
secondary_mapping.transform: z-standardize predictors using only frozen geography rows, estimate PCA using geography only, orient PC1 so its correlation with distance is positive, then min-max scale PC1 to [0,1]
secondary_mapping.reason: Tests whether opportunity-space constraint is better represented by remoteness plus island capacity/relief without fitting biological outcomes.

sensitivity_rules: Report both distance_ecdf and geography_only_pc1; do not choose between them based on fit.
Use the full pre-existing v4 saturation envelope 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0; do not select a preferred saturation post hoc.

If a geography field is unavailable for a frozen island, retain that row for distance-only analysis if dist is available and mark it missing for geography-PC1; never impute a value from network outcomes.
Archipelago/system identity is a clustering variable, not an extra constraint score.
Sampling effort may adjust the observed network target but never the ABM geography input.

tier_B_matrix_derived_after_byte_gate: plant niche overlap or source-compatible analogue
first_prediction_targets.functional_endpoint: reproduction remains external/mechanistic validation and is not required to decline monotonically with geography

validation.stage_1: out-of-sample rank/direction recovery at actual island/network locations
validation.stage_2: leave-one-system-out scale calibration only after stage_1 is reported, with held-out system outcomes excluded from calibration
validation.sampling_effort_boundary: Observed richness/link targets must retain sampling-time/effort information. Effort correction is a measurement model and may not alter the frozen geography-to-constraint mapping.

forbidden: fit weights on distance, area or elevation using network outcomes before the primary test
replace frozen systems because their predictions are poor
select a saturation value based on named-system fit
treat study sampling area as island area
treat missing geography or matrix bytes as zero
